svg.desc: Two panels of the private information not yet in the price, as a share of its prior variance. Top, Kyle's continuous auction, against trading time from 0 to 1, the close: the share falls in a straight line, one minus the time, from 1 to zero at the close, the same at any level of noise trading; at the middle of the session half is left, and the price then carries 0.347 nats, half a bit, about the value. Bottom, Glosten and Milgrom's example with values 1 and 11, a prior of one half and liquidity traders who buy or sell with probability one half, against the number of trades from 0 to 400, for an insider share of 0.1 (orange) and 0.2 (dark): the expected share left is 0.648, 0.448, 0.229 and 0.068 after 50, 100, 200 and 400 trades at 0.1, and 0.224, 0.065, 0.007 and below 0.001 at 0.2; a dot on each curve marks 100 trades. One trade carries 0.0050 and 0.0201 nats about the value at the start, and its relative entropy between the two values is 0.0201 and 0.0811 nats. The two panels are not on a common clock. The curves are this book's derivation from the models, and every number is this book's calculation.
